item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 15/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad band of clouds will bring rainy weather to the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. An intense winter monsoon will reach the coastal areas tomorrow night. Temperatures will fall progressively. It will be cold and windy over Guangdong during the weekend and early next week, and the weather will improve. Under the influence of a replenishment of the monsoon, it will still be rather cool in the morning and at night over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 16/12 (Friday)
Wind: North force 4, force 5 later, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy with a few rain patches. Temperatures will fall progressively at night.
Temp range: 14 - 18 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
